product_overview: A backend-only ERP foundation platform providing shared security, configuration, file handling, lookup, role/user management, and notification services. It exposes stateless JWT-protected REST APIs for administrative and runtime operations across modules.
core_goals: Provide secure stateless authentication and authorization for all protected APIs
Enable runtime management of platform configuration without redeployment
Support reusable file upload, categorization, secure download, and lifecycle management
Offer centralized lookup, module/page/role/user administration for security and reference data
Deliver notification template, channel, dispatch, and log management APIs

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to log in, refresh and revoke tokens, recover accounts, activate accounts, and retrieve their own identity details using stateless JWT authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken and refreshToken -> GET /api/v1/security/auth/me with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with self identity and roles
POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

POST /api/v1/security/auth/refresh with valid refreshToken -> Receive 200 with rotated accessToken and refreshToken -> POST /api/v1/security/auth/logout with Bearer accessToken and refreshToken -> Receive 204 no content

POST /api/v1/security/auth/forgot-password with valid email -> Receive 202 accepted neutral response -> POST /api/v1/security/auth/reset-password with expired or invalid token -> Receive 400 validation or token error

features.name: Current User Dashboard
features.description: Returns the authenticated caller's assigned dashboard modules and nested navigation menu tree based on the JWT principal.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/security/me/modules with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with list of dashboard modules
GET /api/v1/security/me/menu with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with nested navigation tree
GET /api/v1/security/me/modules without Authorization header -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT
GET /api/v1/security/me/menu with expired Bearer token -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT

features.name: Security Lookups
features.description: Resolves security-related lookup values by lookup key for any authenticated caller.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/security/lookups/{lookupKey} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with lookup values
GET /api/v1/security/lookups/{lookupKey} with unknown lookupKey -> Receive 404 unknown lookup key
GET /api/v1/security/lookups/{lookupKey} without Bearer token -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT

features.name: Module Registry
features.description: Manages security modules as tier-1 grantable units, including create, search, view, update, and soft deactivation.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/modules with valid moduleCode, names, and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created module -> GET /api/v1/security/modules/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with module details
POST /api/v1/security/modules with duplicate moduleCode -> Receive 400 duplicate moduleCode validation error
POST /api/v1/security/modules/search with filter criteria and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated module results
PUT /api/v1/security/modules/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found
DELETE /api/v1/security/modules/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and module soft-deactivated

features.name: Page Registry
features.description: Manages security pages and auto-generates permissions when pages are created, with search, update, view, and soft deactivation.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/pages with valid pageCode, moduleFk, and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created page and generated permissions
POST /api/v1/security/pages with duplicate pageCode or invalid moduleFk -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/security/pages/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated page results
PUT /api/v1/security/pages/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found
DELETE /api/v1/security/pages/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and page soft-deactivated

features.name: Permission Registry
features.description: Provides read-only listing of permissions with optional filters for page, module, and permission type.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/security/permissions?pageFk={pageFk}&moduleFk={moduleFk}&permissionType=VIEW with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated permissions
GET /api/v1/security/permissions?permissionType=INVALID with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with empty or filtered results according to backend validation rules
GET /api/v1/security/permissions without Bearer token -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT

features.name: Role Management
features.description: Supports role CRUD plus granting and revoking modules and permissions for RBAC administration.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/roles with valid roleCode and names plus Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created role -> POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules with moduleId -> Receive 200 with module grant confirmation -> POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions with permissionId -> Receive 200 with permission grant confirmation
POST /api/v1/security/roles with duplicate roleCode -> Receive 400 duplicate roleCode validation error
POST /api/v1/security/roles/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated role results
DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions/{permissionId} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with permission revoked confirmation
DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and role soft-deactivated

features.name: User Management
features.description: Manages user accounts with lifecycle fields and role assignment, while excluding password changes from the general user update endpoint.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/users with valid user profile data and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created pending-activation user -> POST /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles with roleId -> Receive 200 with role assignment confirmation -> GET /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with assigned roles list
POST /api/v1/security/users with duplicate username -> Receive 400 duplicate username validation error
GET /api/v1/security/users?username=jdoe&isActiveFl=true with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated user results
PUT /api/v1/security/users/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found
DELETE /api/v1/security/users/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and user marked inactive

features.name: Common Configurations (CU)
features.description: Provides runtime key/value configuration management for platform operators, including create, search, get, update, and deactivate actions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/common/configurations with configKey, configValue, and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created configuration -> GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with configuration details -> PUT /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} with new configValue -> Receive 200 with updated configuration
POST /api/v1/common/configurations with duplicate configKey -> Receive 400 configuration key already exists validation error
POST /api/v1/common/configurations/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated configuration list
PUT /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} with non-existent key -> Receive 404 not found
DELETE /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and configuration deactivated

features.name: File Categories
features.description: Allows administrators to define and maintain file/document categories with size and content-type constraints.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files/categories with valid categoryCode, names, and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created category -> GET /api/v1/files/categories/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with category details
POST /api/v1/files/categories with duplicate categoryCode -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/files/categories/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated category results
PUT /api/v1/files/categories/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found
DELETE /api/v1/files/categories/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and category deactivated

features.name: File Management
features.description: Supports secure upload, metadata access, listing, tokenized download, and archive/delete operations for files owned by any module.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files as multipart/form-data with file, ownerId, ownerType, and moduleCode plus Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with file metadata -> POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with short-lived download token -> GET /api/v1/files/download?token={token} -> Receive 200 with binary file content
POST /api/v1/files with missing ownerId or ownerType or moduleCode -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/v1/files/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with file metadata
GET /api/v1/files without Bearer token -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT
DELETE /api/v1/files/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with archived or deleted file metadata
GET /api/v1/files/download?token=expiredToken -> Receive 401 invalid or expired token

features.name: File Lookups
features.description: Returns file module lookup options for UI dropdowns, such as file type and file status.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/files/lookups/FILE_FILE_TYPE with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with lookup options
GET /api/v1/files/lookups/UNKNOWN_KEY with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 404 not found for unknown lookupKey
GET /api/v1/files/lookups/FILE_FILE_STATUS without Bearer token -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT

features.name: MDM Lookup Management
features.description: Provides master lookup type and lookup value CRUD for reference data administration, including parent-scoped value management and soft deletion.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types with valid typeCode and names plus Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created lookup type -> POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/{typeId}/values with valueCode and names -> Receive 200 with created lookup value -> GET /api/v1/mdm/lookup-values/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with lookup value details
POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types with duplicate typeCode -> Receive 400 duplicate typeCode validation error
POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated lookup type results
PUT /api/v1/mdm/lookup-values/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found
DELETE /api/v1/mdm/lookup-values/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and lookup value soft-deactivated

features.name: MDM Lookup Consumption
features.description: Provides active lookup values by natural type code for any authenticated consumer across the platform.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/mdm/lookups/{typeCode} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with active lookup values
GET /api/v1/mdm/lookups/{typeCode} for unknown or inactive type code -> Receive 404 unknown or inactive type code
GET /api/v1/mdm/lookups/{typeCode} without Bearer token -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT

features.name: Notification Dispatch
features.description: Dispatches notifications to recipients via one or more channels using templates, creating notification logs for each requested channel.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with recipientId, templateCode, channelHint, moduleCode, and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with dispatch response and created notification logs
POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with unknown templateCode or recipientId -> Receive 404 template or recipient not found

features.name: Notification Channels
features.description: Manages notification channel configurations, including enable/disable state and channel configuration payloads.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/channels with valid channelTypeId and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created channel config -> GET /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with channel details -> PUT /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} with isEnabledFl=false -> Receive 200 with updated channel
POST /api/v1/notifications/channels with duplicate channelTypeId -> Receive 400 duplicate channelTypeId validation error
POST /api/v1/notifications/channels/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated channel results
DELETE /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and channel disabled
GET /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Notification Templates
features.description: Manages bilingual notification templates with subject, body, attachment linkage, search, update, and soft deactivation.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/templates with valid templateCode, bilingual names, and body content plus Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with created template -> GET /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with template details -> PUT /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} with updated bilingual body -> Receive 200 with updated template
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates with duplicate templateCode -> Receive 400 duplicate templateCode validation error
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated template results
DELETE /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 204 no content and template deactivated
GET /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Notification Logs
features.description: Provides read-only search and retrieval of notification dispatch logs.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/logs/search with filters and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with paginated notification log results
GET /api/v1/notifications/logs/{id} with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with notification log details
GET /api/v1/notifications/logs/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Notification Lookups
features.description: Returns runtime lookup values for notification channel and status options used by the notification module.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/NOTIF_CHANNEL with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with lookup values
GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/NOTIF_STATUS with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with lookup values
GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/UNKNOWN_KEY with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 404 unknown lookup key
GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/NOTIF_CHANNEL without Bearer token -> Receive 401 missing or invalid JWT

tech_stack: Spring Security (stateless JWT — no HTTP Basic)

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Login, JWT token rotation, logout, self-service account recovery (forgot/reset/activate), and self identity. The only module with public pre-auth endpoints. All protected endpoints require Authorization Bearer <accessToken> obtained from login.

endpoints.description: Request password reset, neutral response to prevent account enumeration
Reset password with a valid token

response_schema.400: Validation error / invalid or expired token / weak password

endpoints.description: Activate account with a valid token, optionally set password

response_schema.400: Validation error / invalid or expired token

endpoints.description: Self identity, roles and granted modules/permissions

features.name: Current User Dashboard
features.description: Self-scoped dashboard modules and nested navigation menu tree for the authenticated caller (resolved from JWT principal).

features.name: Security Lookups
features.description: Runtime SEC lookup-of-values (LOV) resolution by key. Read-only, any authenticated caller.

features.name: Module Registry
features.description: Security module registry CRUD (Tier-1 grantable units). DELETE is soft-deactivate.

features.name: Page Registry
features.description: Security screen/page registry CRUD. Create auto-generates permissions. DELETE is soft-deactivate.

response_schema.400: Validation error / duplicate pageCode / bad moduleFk

features.name: Permission Registry
features.description: Read-only screen permission listing (Tier-2 picker). GET with query-param filters; no write endpoints (permissions auto-generated).

features.name: Role Management
features.description: RBAC roles CRUD plus Tier-1 module grant/revoke and Tier-2 permission grant/revoke on the same controller. CRUD delete is soft-deactivate (204); grant/revoke return a 200 status envelope.

features.name: User Management
features.description: Security user account management plus role assign/revoke/list. Create carries NO password (account starts PENDING_ACTIVATION). Search is GET with query params; DELETE is soft-deactivate.

endpoints.description: Create user (no password; activation flow sets it)
Update user (username immutable; password not updatable here)

features.name: Common Configurations (CU)
features.description: Key-value system configuration management, exposed via com.erp.cu module

endpoints.description: Update an existing configuration entry by configKey
Get a configuration entry by configKey
Deactivate a configuration entry by configKey

features.name: File Categories
features.description: CRUD for file/document categories used to classify uploaded files

body.categoryCode: string (required, max 50, immutable after creation, example "CONTRACTS")

endpoints.description: Get a file category by id
Update a file category by id (categoryCode immutable)
Deactivate a file category by id

features.name: File Management
features.description: Upload, download, metadata retrieval, listing and deletion of files

endpoints.description: Upload a new file (multipart/form-data — "file" part plus form fields ownerId, ownerType, moduleCode, optional fileCategoryFk via @ModelAttribute)
Issue a short-lived access token for downloading a file
Download a file using a previously issued access token
List files owned by the current user, paginated
Archive or delete a file by id

features.name: File Lookups
features.description: Lookup/option lists used by File module UI dropdowns

endpoints.description: Get lookup options by lookup key (valid keys FILE_FILE_TYPE, FILE_FILE_STATUS)

features.name: MDM Lookup Management
features.description: Reference data lookup management. Master LookupType CRUD and child LookupValue CRUD on one controller. Values are parent-scoped by {typeId}. DELETE endpoints are soft-deactivate.

endpoints.description: Create lookup value within a type

body.valueCode: string (required, @NotBlank, max 50, create-only, unique within type, example "PDF")

endpoints.description: Search lookup values within a type (paginated, parent-scoped)

features.name: MDM Lookup Consumption
features.description: Platform-wide reference-data provider. Any authenticated caller reads ACTIVE values of an ACTIVE type by natural type code.

endpoints.description: Get active lookup values by type code

features.name: Notification Dispatch
features.description: Notification dispatch fan-out. Creates one NOTIF_LOG per requested channel. Success returns 200.

features.name: Notification Channels
features.description: Notification channel config CRUD / enable-disable. Entity has IS_ENABLED_FL only; DELETE is soft-disable.

features.name: Notification Templates
features.description: Notification template CRUD. Bilingual body mandatory. Search is POST /search; DELETE is soft-deactivate.

features.name: Notification Logs
features.description: Notification log query, read-only. No create/update/delete. Empty result returns 200 empty page.

features.name: Notification Lookups
features.description: NOTIF runtime LOV provider (NOTIF_CHANNEL / NOTIF_STATUS). Unknown key yields 404.

endpoints.description: Get notification lookup values by key

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is stateless JWT only — there is NO HTTP Basic auth filter. All protected endpoints require an Authorization Bearer <accessToken> obtained by POSTing credentials to /api/v1/security/auth/login. Basic auth (admin/admin) is NOT accepted on protected endpoints.
known_limitations.impact: Any test hitting a protected endpoint with Basic auth will get 401. Tests must log in via /api/v1/security/auth/login, read data.accessToken, and send it as a Bearer token.

known_limitations.issue: SMTP mail health indicator is DOWN locally (no MAIL_PASSWORD configured), so /actuator/health returns overall 503 though all functional components (db, disk, liveness, readiness) are UP.
known_limitations.impact: Notification dispatch scenarios that actually send email may fail locally; the app itself serves API requests normally.

known_limitations.issue: com.erp.common package provides only shared infrastructure (AuditableEntity, ApiResponse envelope, SpecBuilder, exceptions) with no REST endpoints of its own
known_limitations.impact: No standalone endpoints to test under "common"; exercised indirectly through other modules
